Well this was an easy fix.

I had my AI agent scape and contact all 82 pool companies in DFW while I slept.

It sent my plans and survey and said I’d prefer to not hop on a call yet. Just need a ballpark price via email.

I already have 5 prices. 77 to go. The game has changed.

Someone just had an AI agent email 82 pool companies for a ballpark price while they slept.

Five replied. Most never will.

Ballpark on the page beats silence.

hits.draft_en:
A lot of shops measure AI search wrong.

They watch referral traffic and call it flat.

Ask ChatGPT for your trade plus your town. Screenshot who shows up.

If it isn't you, fix the page: services, towns, real job photos. Then check again.

Fun fact from a new study:

Ask ChatGPT about a brand by name and its site gets cited most of the time.

Ask "who's best in this category" and that rate collapses.

Own your name online. Also own the category words: electrician, plumber, your towns.

Getting 10 email quotes overnight doesn't mean you found your electrician.

A cheap number with no license check, no site visit, and no panel photo is just a number.

Ask who pulls the permit. Ask what's included. Meet someone on site before you wire money.

drafts.text:
Ground vs neutral ⚡

Neutral carries current back under normal use.

Ground is the safety path when something fails. It shouldn't carry current day to day.

If your outlet tester shows an open ground, that's not a "maybe later" fix.
